channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — magictools
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Proof Engine — via magictools
item.description: Rust rendering and game engine where every visual is math: glyphs and particles moved by ODEs, strange attractors and force fields, with OpenGL post-processing and synth audio.

item.title: Glitchless — via magictools
item.description: Open-source game observability for Three.js, Phaser, Unity, Godot, Unreal and GameMaker: frame times with hitch causes, crashes, where players quit and player bug reports, plus an MCP server so coding agents can read the data and fix what players hit.

item.title: Slip Sound — via magictools
item.description: Fast, local desktop audio sample manager for searching and organizing large sound libraries. No accounts or file caps, with MCP support. Source

item.title: MeshRig — via magictools
item.description: Rig any mesh in a .blend in minutes: fit a starting skeleton, skin weights and IK. Writes a standard Blender armature that works anywhere a Blender rig does. Source

item.title: MeshCoat — via magictools
item.description: Fast, offline desktop texture painter: load a 3D model and paint PBR materials directly onto the mesh, then export texture maps. Source

item.title: MeshAnimate — via magictools
item.description: Pivot-style pose-to-pose animator for rigged Blender characters, with a simple timeline and onion-skin ghosts. Saves animations back into the .blend as normal Blender actions. Source

item.title: DailySounds — via magictools
item.description: Searchable sound effects for games, with browser previews and downloadable audio; free for commercial projects under the DailySounds license.

item.title: RespawnStack — via magictools
item.description: Free directory of pricing, commercial-use and ownership terms for 30+ AI game-dev tools. Each verified row cites its source (vendor page or Steamworks docs) with a link and date.

item.title: PicMason Sprite Sheet Splitter — via magictools
item.description: Browser-based fixed-grid splitter with custom frame sizes, offsets and spacing. Exports PNG frames preserving source transparency and a ZIP with source coordinates; can skip fully transparent frames.

item.title: Inca — via magictools
item.description: Free, open-source 3D modeling, animation and rendering app that works like Maya 2020, with OBJ, FBX, glTF and STL import.

item.title: WishlistForge Steam Description Scorer — via magictools
item.description: free in-browser scorer for Steam short descriptions. It checks length, hook, genre clarity, player fantasy and call to action, and suggests a rewrite. No account needed.

item.title: Sprite Fusion Sprite Normals — via magictools
item.description: Generate normal maps from pixel art sprites and animations.

item.title: Pic2SVG — via magictools
item.description: Raster-to-vector tracing preview for inspecting flat artwork intended for game icons or UI. Free anonymous split preview and enlarged view; downloads require Pro. Images are processed on the server.

item.title: StarterLoot — via magictools
item.description: Free directory of 80+ beginner friendly AI game dev tools, with guides like Godot vs Unity.

item.title: PulseLite UI SFX — via magictools
item.description: 20 free UI sounds (clicks, hovers, confirms, errors, rewards) in WAV/OGG, procedurally synthesized with no samples or AI audio models, sounds CC BY 4.0, plus an optional Godot 4 drop-in script (MIT).

item.title: Gamifying — via magictools
item.description: Browser workspace for game design: characters, quests, items and lore as linked entries, with Kanban board, timeline and JSON export.

item.title: CICA AUDIO — via magictools
item.description: AI sound effect generator for games and UI. Analyzes gameplay recordings, detects sound events, and generates synchronized WAV files.

item.title: BatchSet — via magictools
item.description: Compress and convert whole folders of PNG, JPG and WebP sprites in the browser, nothing uploaded.

item.title: Soundza — via magictools
item.description: Thousands of free game sound effects, music loops and ambience in WAV/MP3, made by people rather than AI; free for commercial use, no attribution needed. Free API and MCP server.

item.title: Mibo — via magictools
item.description: Elmish (MVU) F# game framework on raylib-cs or MonoGame.

item.title: IndieToolChest — via magictools
item.description: Curated directory of AI tools for indie game dev, organized by task (art, 3D, audio, NPCs, code, QA, marketing).

item.title: Nu Game Engine — via magictools
item.description: Functional 2D/3D game engine in F# (free for noncommercial use; paid commercial license).

item.title: AnimGen Free Sprite Sheet Tools — via magictools
item.description: Browser tools that convert GIFs to sprite sheets and back, slice grid sheets or auto-extract sprites from sheets with no grid, export PNG sequences, and remove solid or green-screen GIF backgrounds. Files stay on your device; sheets come with Aseprite-format JSON.

item.title: Remove Audio Noise Remover — via magictools
item.description: Clean hiss, hum, wind and crowd noise out of voice lines, dialogue and trailer voice-overs with AI, free in the browser (optional paid Cloud mode for long files).

item.title: SFXMint — via magictools
item.description: CC0 game and UI sound effects in WAV/MP3; AI-generated or procedurally synthesized, with no signup required for library downloads.

item.title: Bounty Board Arcade SDK — via magictools
item.description: Rewarded ads, leaderboards and cloud saves for HTML5 games published on the Bounty Board Arcade.

item.title: Sprite Sheet Builder — via magictools
item.description: Free browser-based sprite sheet maker: pack frames, split atlases, convert GIFs, export PNG + JSON/XML for Unity, Godot, Phaser and FNF.

item.title: BudgetPixel Sound Effects — via magictools
item.description: 2,600+ AI-generated sound effects (UI clicks, impacts, whooshes) and 700+ music tracks, WAV/MP3, CC BY 4.0.

item.title: Parlour — via magictools
item.description: Deterministic TypeScript card-game engine with a cozy playable browser table (Blitz, Wild, P2P rooms, no backend).

item.title: Nebula Forge — via magictools
item.description: Browser-based procedural nebula background generator with adjustable controls and PNG export. Runs locally without signup.

item.title: AI Workflow for Game Designers — via magictools
WTF Games — via magictools
item.description: Free HTML5 games playable directly in the browser without downloads or registration.

item.title: GameFrameX — via magictools
item.description: A cross-engine game framework: Unity and Godot clients on a single actor-model .NET server, sharing one Protobuf contract and LuBan config pipeline. AI-agent friendly: instruction docs in-repo, codegen'd protocol/config layers.

item.title: WorldLoop — via magictools
item.description: Procedural architecture and world generation combining semantic CAD, playable structures, voxel terrain, caves and water, with direct export to Roblox Studio
